mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains ≤ 0.25% for 6 consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods over the next 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month and S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of such events over the next 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) relative to prior month indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of such periods over the next 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.5% and INDPRO declines relative to prior month but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of such cases over the next 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL level above 215.0 indicates moderate inflation that supports corporate profit growth without triggering aggressive rate hikes, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 215.0 and S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods over the next 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2.0% signals sustained economic expansion that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate remains > 2.0% for 3 consecutive quarters and S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods over the next 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) relative to prior month indicate a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods over the next 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) level above 97.5 indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains > 97.5 for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods over the next 5 years.
